posts.title: Permacomputer Text Editor Devlog #2
posts.description: The proof-of-concept Tiny BASIC text editor that the people’s permacomputer project sponsors has hit another milestone. The text editor has added a primitive edit mode. posts.title: Permacomputer Text Editor Devlog #1
posts.description: Progress has been made on the text editor that will be shipped on the first model of the people’s permacomputer. Please follow the code development here: https://codeberg.org/vidak/peoples Also, have a look at an earlier, historical editor from which this one was inspired, “VIC EDITYPE”: http://www.vic20listings.freeolamail.com/book_computevic2.html Forum thread here: https://basiclang.solarpunk.a
